quote_cn: 我只是个孩子，为什么要承受这些……
quote_en: I'm just a kid, why do I have to endure this...
desc_cn: 均衡型角色，基础 3 红心。携带炸弹和 The Dice（可重 roll 道具），是最标准的初始角色。
desc_en: Balanced character with 3 red hearts. Carries bombs and The Dice. The most standard starting character.
char_desc_cn: 万金油型人格。没有极端特点，代表最普通的人面对困境时的真实反应。既不特别勇敢也不特别怯懦，既不贪婪也不吝啬。他是所有人的起点，也是大多数人的真实写照——在混乱中寻找方向。
char_desc_en: Jack-of-all-trades personality. No extreme traits — represents the most genuine human reaction to adversity. Neither especially brave nor especially cowardly. He is everyone's starting point and most people's true reflection — finding direction in chaos.

quote_cn: 来，让我治愈你的伤痛。
quote_en: Come, let me heal your wounds.
desc_cn: 高血量（4 红心），携带 Yum Heart（回复 1 红心）。移速较慢，适合肉盾型打法。
desc_en: High HP (4 red hearts), carries Yum Heart (heals 1 red heart). Slow speed, tank-style play.
char_desc_cn: 温暖的守护者。总是冲在前面为别人挡刀，哪怕自己也在流血。过度的善良有时是一种负担，但她从不后悔。她相信爱能治愈一切，哪怕这个世界充满了恶意。
char_desc_en: A warm guardian. Always charges ahead to shield others, even while bleeding herself. Excessive kindness can be a burden, but she never regrets it. She believes love can heal everything, even in a world full of malice.

quote_cn: 运气？不，这叫实力。
quote_en: Luck? No, this is skill.
desc_cn: 高幸运值，携带 Lucky Foot。攻击力尚可但血量较少。赌博和献血时运气更好。
desc_en: High luck, carries Lucky Foot. Decent attack but low HP. Better luck gambling and donating blood.
char_desc_cn: 赌徒与冒险家，天生幸运儿。他相信每一次门后都有宝藏，每一个骰子都该掷出 6。高风险高回报是他的信条，输了？再来一把。运气不是天上掉的，是他自己争取的。
char_desc_en: Gambler and adventurer, born lucky. He believes every door hides treasure and every die should roll 6. High risk, high reward is his creed. Lost? Deal again. Luck isn't given — he earns it.

quote_cn: 背叛是通向力量最短的捷径。
quote_en: Betrayal is the shortest path to power.
desc_cn: 1 红心开局，携带 The Book of Belial。高攻击低血量的玻璃大炮。恶魔房概率加成。
desc_en: Starts with 1 red heart, carries The Book of Belial. Glass cannon with high attack, low HP. Devil room chance bonus.
char_desc_cn: 深谋远虑的暗影行者。不介意用黑暗的手段达成目的，因为光明从来不是免费的。高攻击力的代价是脆弱的身躯，但他相信：最好的防御就是进攻。他是所有叛徒中最忠诚的那个。
char_desc_en: A calculating shadow walker. Doesn't mind using dark means to achieve goals, because light is never free. High attack power at the cost of fragility — he believes the best defense is offense. The most loyal among all traitors.

quote_cn: 绝境？那是我的主场。
quote_en: Desperation? That's my arena.
desc_cn: 携带 Whore of Babylon（低血量时大幅提升攻击力）和 Dead Bird。低血量时才是完全体。
desc_en: Carries Whore of Babylon (massive attack boost at low HP) and Dead Bird. Full power at low HP.
char_desc_cn: 绝境求生者。血量越低越强大，濒死状态才是她的完全体。她习惯了在刀尖上跳舞，因为安逸让她窒息。自残是一种策略，也是一种生活态度——痛苦让她清醒。
char_desc_en: Desperation survivor. Lower HP means greater power — near-death is her true form. She's used to dancing on the edge because comfort suffocates her. Self-harm is strategy and lifestyle — pain keeps her lucid.

desc_cn: 全程只有灵魂之魂（Soul Hearts），没有红心。不能使用红心回复。携带 The Poop。
desc_en: Only Soul Hearts, no red hearts. Cannot use red heart healing. Carries The Poop.
char_desc_cn: 沉默的混沌体。无法用言语描述，无法用常理揣度。他以灵魂为血量，用便便作为武器，活在一个所有人都不理解他的世界里。但也许，不被理解本身就是一种自由。
char_desc_en: A silent chaos entity. Defies description and logic. Uses souls as HP and poop as weapon, living in a world nobody understands. But perhaps being misunderstood is itself a form of freedom.

quote_cn: 以血换力，绝不后悔。
quote_en: Blood for power, no regrets.
desc_cn: 携带 Bloody Lust（每次受伤临时提升攻击力，最多叠加 6 次）。被打得越狠，输出越高。
desc_en: Carries Bloody Lust (attack boost on hit, stacks up to 6x). More damage taken = more damage dealt.
char_desc_cn: 狂暴战士，用生命换取力量。他不懂什么叫退缩，不知道什么叫克制。被打得越惨，反击越狠。暴力是他唯一的语言，但他用得很好。
char_desc_en: Berserker warrior who trades life for power. He doesn't know retreat or restraint. The harder he's hit, the harder he strikes back. Violence is his only language, and he speaks it fluently.

quote_cn: 翅膀比光环好用多了。
quote_en: Wings are way more useful than halos.
desc_cn: 拥有飞行能力和短程 Brimstone 激光。射程短但伤害极高，前期最强角色之一。初始 3 黑心。
desc_en: Flight ability and short-range Brimstone laser. Short range but extreme damage. One of the strongest early-game characters. Starts with 3 black hearts.
char_desc_cn: 堕天使的骄傲。拥有飞行能力和强力射线，是天生的破坏者。自负是他的保护色，短程是他唯一的软肋。他不后悔堕落，因为天堂太无聊了。
char_desc_en: The pride of fallen angels. Flight and powerful beams make him a natural destroyer. Arrogance is his armor, short range his only weakness. He doesn't regret falling — heaven was too boring.

quote_cn: 死过一次的人，不怕再死。
quote_en: Someone who's died once isn't afraid to die again.
desc_cn: 携带 Anemic。死亡后自动复活为 Lazarus Risen（攻击力大幅提升）。唯一自带复活的角色。
desc_en: Carries Anemic. Auto-revives as Lazarus Risen (massive attack boost) on death. Only character with built-in revival.
char_desc_cn: 复活者。死亡对他来说不是终点，而是新的开始。这种近乎鲁莽的乐观让他敢于做别人不敢做的事。反正能复活，怕什么？每一次死亡都是一次升级。
char_desc_en: The Risen. Death isn't an ending but a new beginning. His reckless optimism lets him dare what others won't. He can revive anyway — what's to fear? Every death is an upgrade.

quote_cn: 下一秒会发生什么，谁也说不准。
quote_en: What happens next, nobody can say.
desc_cn: 每局随机初始道具、属性和外观。使用 Eden Token 进入。完全的随机性角色。
desc_en: Random starting items, stats, and appearance each run. Requires Eden Token to enter. Fully random character.
char_desc_cn: 混沌的化身。每次开局都是全新的随机状态，他从不抱怨命运的不公，因为公平从来不存在。适应力是他最强的武器，随机性是他最好的朋友。
char_desc_en: The embodiment of chaos. Every run starts with random state — he never complains about unfairness because fairness never existed. Adaptability is his greatest weapon, randomness his best friend.

quote_cn: 碰一下就碎，所以绝不能被碰到。
quote_en: One touch and I shatter, so I must never be touched.
desc_cn: 一碰即死，但拥有 Holy Mantle（每房间一次免伤）和永恒D6。免费恶魔房。在安全网下追求极限。
desc_en: One-hit death, but has Holy Mantle (one free hit per room) and Eternal D6. Free devil deals. Pursues perfection with a safety net.
char_desc_cn: 他有安全网。Holy Mantle 每房间挡一次死亡，永恒 D6 可以重置不满意的道具——代价是它可能直接消失。他代表了那种在有退路的前提下追求极致表现的人：允许试探，允许犯一次错，但绝不会有第二次。一碰即死的脆弱让他比任何人都更珍惜每一次机会。
char_desc_en: He has a safety net. Holy Mantle blocks one death per room; the Eternal D6 rerolls unsatisfying items — at the cost of possibly erasing them. He represents those who chase perfection with a fallback: allowed to probe, allowed one mistake, but never a second. One-hit fragility makes him value every opportunity more than anyone.

quote_cn: 黑暗中，我从不孤单。
quote_en: In the darkness, I'm never alone.
desc_cn: 携带 Incubus（跟随射击的恶魔宝宝）和 Cambion Conception。自身射程短，靠召唤物输出。
desc_en: Carries Incubus (follower demon baby) and Cambion Conception. Short personal range, relies on summons for damage.
char_desc_cn: 召唤者与母亲。她不亲自战斗，而是让她的孩子们替她冲锋。这种间接的战斗方式反映了一种深层的依赖与被依赖——她需要被需要，她的孩子们也需要她。
char_desc_en: Summoner and mother. She doesn't fight personally — her children charge for her. This indirect combat reflects deep dependency — she needs to be needed, and her children need her too.

quote_cn: 一分钱掰两半花。
quote_en: A penny saved is a penny earned.
desc_cn: 使用金币作为血量（最多 2 金币容器），不能持有灵魂心。拾取金币可回血。商店折扣。
desc_en: Uses coins as HP (max 2 coin containers). Cannot hold soul hearts. Picking up coins heals. Shop discount.
char_desc_cn: 极端节俭者。金币就是血量，血量就是金币，他活在一个经济与生命直接挂钩的世界里。每一分钱都要精打细算，因为他输不起。别人眼中的吝啬，在他看来是生存智慧。
char_desc_en: Extreme frugalist. Coins are HP, HP is coins — he lives where economy and life are directly linked. Every cent must be carefully calculated because he can't afford to lose. What others call stingy, he calls survival wisdom.

quote_cn: 吞噬一切，化为己用。
quote_en: Devour everything, make it your own.
desc_cn: 携带 Void（可吞噬其他道具获得属性加成或能力）。代表虚无与吞噬。
desc_en: Carries Void (devours items for stat bonuses or abilities). Represents void and consumption.
char_desc_cn: 虚空的使者。他能把任何道具转化为力量，代表了一种「万物皆可为我所用」的实用主义。他不挑剔，不感性，只要能变强，什么都可以牺牲。沉默寡言，但实力深不可测。
char_desc_en: Emissary of the void. Can convert any item into power — pragmatic to the core. Not picky, not sentimental — anything can be sacrificed for strength. Quiet but unfathomably powerful.

quote_cn: 信仰是我最强的武器。
quote_en: Faith is my strongest weapon.
desc_cn: 使用魂心充能主动道具。可携带 Book of Virtues（生成火焰跟班）。拉撒路的姐妹。
desc_en: Uses soul hearts to charge active items. Can carry Book of Virtues (generates flame wisps). Lazarus's sister.
char_desc_cn: 虔诚的火焰使者。她用魂心充能，用书本召唤火焰，代表了信仰的力量。她相信善有善报，相信坚持就是胜利，哪怕世界充满了恶意。火焰是她的祈祷，也是她的武器。
char_desc_en: Devout flame bearer. Charges with soul hearts, summons flames from books — the power of faith incarnate. She believes good is rewarded and persistence wins, even in a world of malice. Flames are her prayer and her weapon.

quote_cn: 兄弟齐心，其利断金。
quote_en: Brothers united, unstoppable.
desc_cn: 同时操控两个角色。雅各灵活但血低，以扫血高但笨重。可分别持有道具，兄弟间可交换。
desc_en: Control two characters simultaneously. Jacob is agile but fragile, Esau is tanky but slow. Each can hold different items, can swap between brothers.
char_desc_cn: 双生羁绊。两人共享一个屏幕，需要同时操控。代表了合作与牺牲的永恒主题——有时一个人必须为另一个人挡子弹。他们争吵、妥协、互相扶持，就像所有真实的兄弟一样。
char_desc_en: Twin bond. Two characters sharing one screen, controlled simultaneously. Represents the eternal themes of cooperation and sacrifice — sometimes one must take a bullet for the other. They argue, compromise, and support each other like real brothers.

quote_cn: 骨头是我最后的盔甲，也是我唯一的武器。
quote_en: Bones are my last armor and my only weapon.
desc_cn: 使用骨头近战武器（可蓄力投掷）。只有骨心。有副角色「灵魂」可切换飞行射击。
desc_en: Uses bone melee weapon (chargeable throw). Only bone hearts. Sub-character The Soul can switch to flight and shooting.
char_desc_cn: 死而未腐的战士。他只剩一副骨架，却比大多数活人都顽强。骨头是他的盔甲，灵魂是他最后的火种。他代表了那些被命运碾碎后依然站立的人——你可以夺走我的血肉，但夺不走我的意志。
char_desc_en: Undead warrior. Only a skeleton remains, yet more tenacious than most living beings. Bones are his armor, soul his last spark. He represents those still standing after being crushed by fate — you can take my flesh, but not my will.

quote_cn: 选择太多，也是一种诅咒。
quote_en: Too many choices is also a curse.
desc_cn: 道具栏上限扩展为 12 格，但每获得新道具时必须选择丢弃一个。
desc_en: Inventory expanded to 12 slots, but must discard one item when gaining a new one.
char_desc_cn: 选择困难症的极致体现。他能携带更多道具，但必须不断做出取舍。这代表了现代人面对过多选择时的焦虑——拥有一切，却无法拥有一切。每一个选择都是一次失去。
char_desc_en: The ultimate choice anxiety. Can carry more items but must constantly make trade-offs. Represents modern anxiety about too many choices — having everything yet unable to have everything. Every choice is a loss.

quote_cn: 治愈？不，这次我选择撕碎一切。
quote_en: Healing? No, this time I choose to tear everything apart.
desc_cn: 红心会缓慢流失，但拥有强大的近战咬击。击杀敌人有概率掉落红心。
desc_en: Red hearts slowly drain, but has powerful melee bite attack. Kills have a chance to drop red hearts.
char_desc_cn: 温柔的另一面是暴虐。堕化抹大拉放弃了治愈能力，换取了近战撕咬。代表了那些长期压抑自我的人终于爆发的状态——不再当老好人了。
char_desc_en: The violent side of gentleness. Tainted Magdalene traded healing for melee biting. Represents those who've suppressed themselves too long finally erupting — no more being the nice one.

quote_cn: 万物皆可拆解，万物皆可重组。
quote_en: Everything can be dismantled, everything can be reassembled.
desc_cn: 携带 Bag of Crafting。不能正常拾取道具，所有道具自动分解为材料，可合成新道具。
desc_en: Carries Bag of Crafting. Cannot pick up items normally — all items auto-dismantle into materials for crafting new items.
char_desc_cn: 工匠与破坏者。他不靠运气，靠双手。任何道具都能被拆解为材料，再合成新的东西。这是极端的实用主义——没有什么是神圣的，一切都可以被改造。
char_desc_en: Artisan and destroyer. Doesn't rely on luck — relies on hands. Any item can be dismantled and reassembled. Extreme pragmatism — nothing is sacred, everything can be remade.

quote_cn: 黑暗不再是我的选择，而是我的本质。
quote_en: Darkness is no longer my choice — it's my essence.
desc_cn: 携带 Dark Arts（短暂暗影状态，穿墙且接触敌人造成伤害）。无法获得红心，只有黑心。
desc_en: Carries Dark Arts (brief shadow state, phase through walls, contact damage). Cannot gain red hearts, only black hearts.
char_desc_cn: 与黑暗彻底合一。他不再使用黑暗力量，他本身就是黑暗。Dark Arts 让他穿墙、无敌、造成范围伤害——他就是阴影中的死神。背叛不再是手段，而是本能。
char_desc_en: Completely merged with darkness. No longer uses dark power — he IS darkness. Dark Arts lets him phase through walls, become invincible, deal AoE damage — he's the reaper of shadows. Betrayal is no longer strategy, it's instinct.

desc_cn: 用便便代替炸弹。不同类型的便便有不同效果。携带 Hold（可存储便便下次使用）。
desc_en: Uses poop instead of bombs. Different poop types have different effects. Carries Hold (store poop for later use).
char_desc_cn: 把最被人看不起的东西变成了最强的武器。他不追求高雅，不在乎世俗眼光，用最原始的方式解决问题。有时候，最低级的手段反而最有效。
char_desc_en: Turned the most despised thing into the strongest weapon. Doesn't pursue refinement or care about judgment — solves problems in the most primal way. Sometimes the crudest methods are the most effective.

quote_cn: 我的血，就是我的军队。
quote_en: My blood is my army.
desc_cn: 携带 Sumptorium（消耗红心生成血块跟班）。停止射击时自动将红心转化为血块。血块越多火力越强。
desc_en: Carries Sumptorium (consumes red hearts to generate blood clot followers). Auto-converts hearts when not shooting. More clots = more firepower.
char_desc_cn: 从绝境战士变为鲜血女王。她用自己的血液召唤军队，每一滴血都是一个忠诚的士兵。她代表了那些为了力量不惜一切代价的人——生命？那只是弹药而已。
char_desc_en: From desperation warrior to blood queen. Summons armies from her own blood — every drop a loyal soldier. Represents those who sacrifice everything for power — life? That's just ammunition.

quote_cn: 愤怒不是情绪，是一种生存状态。
quote_en: Rage isn't an emotion — it's a state of survival.
desc_cn: 携带 Berserk!（进入狂暴状态：大幅加速、伤害翻倍、只能近战）。狂暴中击杀延长持续时间。
desc_en: Carries Berserk! (massive speed boost, double damage, melee only). Kills in berserk extend duration.
char_desc_cn: 狂暴的极致。从被动挨打触发变为自主选择爆发。Berserk 状态下的他是不可阻挡的杀戮机器，但狂暴结束后会陷入短暂虚弱。要么不做，做就做绝。
char_desc_en: Berserker perfected. From passive taking hits to active eruption. In Berserk state he's an unstoppable killing machine, but falls into brief weakness after. Either don't do it, or go all the way.

quote_cn: 一口血痰，足以毁灭世界。
quote_en: One bloody spit can destroy the world.
desc_cn: Brimstone 变为巨大扇形喷射（更宽但更短）。蓄力后释放更强力的喷射。
desc_en: Brimstone becomes a huge fan-shaped blast (wider but shorter). Charge for a stronger blast.
char_desc_cn: 从精准的暗杀者变为狂暴的轰炸机。他不再追求精准，而是用压倒性的火力覆盖一切。管你准不准，炸就完了。
char_desc_en: From precise assassin to raging bomber. No longer seeks precision — overwhelms everything with firepower. Who cares about accuracy? Just blast it.

quote_cn: 我是谁？取决于现在是哪一个我。
quote_en: Who am I? Depends on which me is active.
desc_cn: 携带 Flip，可在「活」和「死」两个状态间切换。每个状态有不同道具栏。进入新房间自动切换。
desc_en: Carries Flip — switch between alive and dead states. Each state has different item slots. Auto-switches on entering new rooms.
char_desc_cn: 双面人。他不断在两个状态间切换，代表了身份认同的困惑和人格的多面性。活与死，不过一念之间。
char_desc_en: Two-faced. Constantly switching between states — represents identity confusion and multi-faceted personality. Life and death, separated by a single thought.

quote_cn: 混沌才是宇宙的常态。
quote_en: Chaos is the norm of the universe.
desc_cn: 每次受伤都会随机重 roll 所有道具和属性。唯一不变的就是变化本身。
desc_en: Every hit randomly rerolls all items and stats. The only constant is change itself.
char_desc_cn: 混沌的极致。每次受伤道具都会随机变化，代表了对确定性的彻底放弃。适应力不是选项，是生存的唯一方式。
char_desc_en: Chaos perfected. Items reroll on every hit — total abandonment of certainty. Adaptability isn't an option, it's the only way to survive.

quote_cn: 死亡不是威胁，是条件。
quote_en: Death isn't a threat — it's a condition.
desc_cn: 一碰即死，无 Holy Mantle，仅一张圣卡护身。1.3x 伤害倍率。只生成攻击性道具，品质≤2 有 20% 概率被重掷。
desc_en: One-hit death, no Holy Mantle — only one Holy Card. 1.3x damage multiplier. Only offensive items spawn; quality ≤2 items have 20% chance to reroll.
char_desc_cn: 他哥哥有安全网，他没有。一张圣卡用完就只剩走位和反应。1.3 倍伤害倍率意味着每一发子弹都必须致命，而道具池只给他攻击性选项——连游戏都在逼他进攻。品质太低的道具还会被自动重掷，仿佛命运也在替他筛选弱者。他代表了不给自己留任何退路的人：要么赢，要么死，没有中间地带。
char_desc_en: His brother has a safety net; he has none. One Holy Card, and after that — pure positioning and reflexes. The 1.3x damage multiplier means every tear must be lethal, and the item pool only offers offensive options — even the game forces him to attack. Low-quality items get rerolled, as if fate itself filters out weakness. He represents those who leave no escape route: win or die, no middle ground.

quote_cn: 嘴巴才是最强的武器。
quote_en: The mouth is the strongest weapon.
desc_cn: Incubus 变为舌头射线（类似鞭子）。只能通过舌头攻击。Gello 可释放胎儿跟班。
desc_en: Incubus becomes tongue ray (whip-like). Can only attack via tongue. Gello releases fetal follower.
char_desc_cn: 从召唤者变为直接攻击者。她的胎儿变成舌头射线，代表了从依赖他人到自己动手的转变。不再躲在别人身后，这次要亲自动手。
char_desc_en: From summoner to direct attacker. Fetus becomes tongue ray — represents the shift from depending on others to doing it yourself. No more hiding behind others — this time, hands-on.

quote_cn: 做买卖，不做亏本生意。
quote_en: Do business, never at a loss.
desc_cn: 金币血量上限提升为 3。击杀敌人掉落金币。商店物品更贵。可雇佣店员跟班。
desc_en: Coin HP cap raised to 3. Enemies drop coins on death. Shop items more expensive. Can hire shopkeeper followers.
char_desc_cn: 商人本色的极致。金币仍然是血量但上限更高。代表了资本主义的极致——一切皆可定价，一切皆可交易。
char_desc_en: The ultimate merchant. Coins still serve as HP but with higher cap. Represents capitalism perfected — everything has a price, everything is tradeable.

quote_cn: 蝗虫过境，寸草不生。
quote_en: Locusts pass, nothing survives.
desc_cn: Void 变为 Abyss（将道具转化为蝗虫跟班）。蝗虫造成接触伤害。从吸收属性变为释放蝗虫大军。
desc_en: Void becomes Abyss (converts items into locust followers). Locusts deal contact damage. From absorbing stats to releasing locust armies.
char_desc_cn: 从吞噬变为释放。他不再吸收道具，而是释放蝗虫大军摧毁一切。积攒了太多，是时候释放了。蝗虫过境，寸草不生。
char_desc_en: From devouring to releasing. No longer absorbs items — unleashes locust armies to destroy everything. Accumulated too much, time to release. Locusts pass, nothing survives.

quote_cn: 信仰的火焰，可以焚烧一切。
quote_en: The flames of faith can burn everything.
desc_cn: 携带 Lemegeton（生成魔法火焰跟班，每个火焰代表一个被动道具效果）。火焰可被击毁。
desc_en: Carries Lemegeton (generates magic flame wisps, each representing a passive item effect). Flames can be destroyed.
char_desc_cn: 从虔诚的祈祷者变为狂热的布道者。她的火焰不再温和，而是具有毁灭性的力量。信仰的极端化——当你足够虔诚，火焰就能焚烧一切，包括自己。
char_desc_en: From devout prayer to fervent preacher. Her flames are no longer gentle — they carry destructive power. Faith taken to extremes — when devout enough, flames burn everything, including yourself.

quote_cn: 黑暗的以扫在身后追赶，我只能不停奔跑。
quote_en: Dark Esau chases behind me — I can only keep running.
desc_cn: Dark Esau 持续追踪雅各。被碰到直接进入恶魔房。无法被杀死，只能用 Anima Sola 暂时束缚。
desc_en: Dark Esau continuously tracks Jacob. Touch sends you to devil room. Cannot be killed, only temporarily restrained with Anima Sola.
char_desc_cn: 被黑暗面追逐的人。Dark Esau 是他兄弟的暗影化身，永远在身后追赶，无法消灭，只能暂时束缚。你可以跑，但你永远跑不掉。
char_desc_en: Chased by his dark side. Dark Esau is his brother's shadow incarnation — always pursuing, cannot be destroyed, only temporarily bound. You can run, but you can never escape.

quote_cn: 灵魂在外面，骨头在里面——一切都颠倒了。
quote_en: Soul outside, bones inside — everything is reversed.
desc_cn: 骨骼不能移动，灵魂必须离开身体去攻击和拾取物品。灵魂可将骨骼扔到新位置。操控完全颠倒。
desc_en: Bones cannot move — soul must leave body to attack and pick up items. Soul can throw bones to new positions. Controls completely reversed.
char_desc_cn: 内外颠倒的存在。灵魂在外面活动，骨骼反而成了需要保护的核心。代表了那些外表坚强、内心脆弱的人——你以为他是硬骨头，其实他的灵魂在外面流浪，无处安放。
char_desc_en: Inside-out existence. Soul operates outside while bones become the core to protect. Represents those who appear tough but are fragile inside — you think he's hard-boned, but his soul wanders outside, homeless.
